HediffDef.label: miner's luck
HediffDef.description: The rock opens for this one. They find the seam on the first stroke, the ore comes out clean, and in the deep places the stone feels warm under their hands, like something asleep.

HediffDef.label: soft hand
HediffDef.description: Sickness passes through this one quickly and leaves little behind, and wounds they tend close clean. Their hands smell faintly of earth after rain, whatever they wash them in.

HediffDef.label: a guest's warmth
HediffDef.description: People open up to this one. Strangers tell them things they have told nobody, quarrels cool when they sit down, and they always seem to know where the spare blanket is.

HediffDef.label: winter in the blood
HediffDef.description: The cold does not bite this one the way it bites the rest. They walk out in the snow with their coat open, and on the longest nights they are the last to come in from the quiet.

HediffDef.label: moon-sleep
HediffDef.description: This one sleeps deep and wakes clear, and their wounds mend in the night as if someone sat with them. On bright nights they can see to work by the moon.

HediffDef.label: a lucky season
HediffDef.description: Things go right for this one this season. A sickness passes them by, a fall doesn't break a bone, and the cats follow them about. It won't last, and they know it.

HediffDef.label: rain-ear
HediffDef.description: This one hears rain a day before it comes, and what they sow in wet ground comes up thick. Frogs sing louder where they walk.

HediffDef.label: the glint
HediffDef.description: Deals go this one's way. Traders find themselves agreeing to prices they didn't mean to, and a coin turns up in their pocket now and then that they don't remember having.

HediffDef.label: sower's luck
HediffDef.description: Seed takes where this one sows it, and the crop they bring in is heavier than it has any right to be.

HediffDef.label: storm-sense
HediffDef.description: This one feels weather coming in their teeth, hours before the sky shows it. The psychic world is louder for them, though they keep their nerve when it roars.

HediffDef.label: hunter's eye
HediffDef.description: This one's shots fly truer than they used to, and game does not hear them coming.

HediffDef.label: healer's touch
HediffDef.description: Wounds close cleaner under this one's hands, and they work quickly and gently at a bedside.

HediffDef.label: fighter's luck
HediffDef.description: This one strikes surer and slips blows better than they used to, and pain takes longer to put them down.

HediffDef.label: sure hand
HediffDef.description: Work goes quicker and truer in this one's hands, and building most of all.

HediffDef.label: road-luck
HediffDef.description: This one's feet are quick and the miles short, and traders find themselves giving a better price than they meant to.

HediffDef.label: far-bank ear
HediffDef.description: Grief and terror sit lighter on this one, and they talk sometimes of a quiet that is always near.

HediffDef.label: dream-sight
HediffDef.description: This one's sleep is deep and quick, and they wake with the feeling of having been somewhere.

HediffDef.label: warm hearth
HediffDef.description: This one's cooking is quick and safe, and people sit easier in their company.

HediffDef.label: green hand
HediffDef.description: Growing things thrive under this one's hands, and beasts trust them sooner than they should. Roots seem to lean toward them.

HediffDef.label: river-luck
HediffDef.description: Fevers wash out of this one like silt, and they move as easily as a current.

HediffDef.label: machine-tongue
HediffDef.description: Machines make sense to this one in a way they did not before. Problems that stump everyone else come apart in their head like clockwork, and the workshop lights flicker when they come in.

HediffDef.label: hollow ear
HediffDef.description: This one has an ear for what is beneath the world. They hear it clearly now, and it does not always let them rest.

HediffDef.label: pale mark
HediffDef.description: A pale sign on the skin, in a shape nobody can name, that was not there before and never fades. People notice it, and some of them look away.

HediffDef.label: bad dreams
HediffDef.description: This one has slept badly for nights, always the same dream, and it follows them into the day. They wake tired, and small hurts are slow to mend.

HediffDef.label: calm from the dark
HediffDef.description: This one was at the edge, and then their mind went still. The calm is cold and complete, and it will not last.
